parole.significato: used to form some demonyms of Tupian origin
parole.testo: From Nheengatu -wara (or a cognate), from Old Tupi -ygûara.

parole.significato: abiu tree (Pouteria caimito)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu abiú, from Old Tupi amyîu. The change in stress is possibly a spelling pronunciation, as both the Indigenous terms are oxytone.

parole.significato: Northern maned sloth (Bradypus torquatus)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu aí-pixuna.

parole.significato: A tree of the species Ficus trigona.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu apuí.

parole.significato: babassu (Attalea speciosa, a tall Brazilian feather palm)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu babasú, from Old Tupi 'ybagûasu.

parole.significato: nightjar (nocturnal bird of the family Caprimulgidae)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu wakuráu, from Old Tupi gûyrakereá.

parole.significato: tree of the species Herrania mariae
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu kakáu-rana. By surface analysis, cacau + -rana.

parole.significato: candiru (a small parasitic fish, Vandellia cirrhosa, native to the Amazon river)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu kandirú.

parole.significato: relating to the Carapanã or to the language (South American indigenous group)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu karapanã.

parole.significato: anhinga (Anhinga anhinga)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu karará.

parole.significato: white-tailed deer (Odocoileus virginianus, a deer of the Americas)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu kariakú, of unknown origin.

parole.significato: a traditional drink of Amazonian origin
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu xibé.

parole.significato: effeminate, lacking virility
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu kunhã-rapixara (literally “similar to a woman”).

parole.significato: cupuassu (Theobroma grandiflorum, a tree of South America)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu kupuasú, from Old Tupi kupu'yûasu.

parole.significato: boy
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu kurumĩ, from Língua Geral Amazônica kurumĩ, from Old Tupi kunumĩ, from Proto-Tupi-Guarani *kunumĩ.

parole.significato: black caiman (Melanosuchus niger, species of large crocodilian)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu yakarewasú, equivalent to jacaré + -açu.

parole.significato: money tree (Pachira aquatica)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu mamãu-rana.

parole.significato: large canoe
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu marakatĩ.

parole.significato: any bird in the genus Pionus
parole.testo: From earlier maitaca /baitaca, borrowed from Nheengatu maitaka.

parole.significato: tree of species Simarouba amara
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu marupá (“Simaroubaceae”), from Old Tupi marupá (“razor”). First attested in 1867.

parole.significato: compact group of water grass, on the banks of rivers and lakes
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu matupã.

parole.significato: the name given to various types of old artefacts of Amazonian origin, carved in stone or wood, and representing animals…
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu muirakitã, from Old Tupi ybyrakytã (“tree knot”).

parole.significato: Nheengatu
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu nheengatú.

parole.significato: a channel separating a braid bar from mainland
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu paraná, from Old Tupi paranã, from Proto-Tupi-Guarani *paranã (“river”). Doublet of Paraná.

parole.significato: marble (small ball used in games)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu peteka.

parole.significato: arapaima (Arapaima gigas)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu pirarukú.

parole.significato: Cyperus lucidus (species of sedge in the family Cyperaceae)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu piripiriáka.

parole.significato: the distinctive odor of fish or raw eggs
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu pitiú, from Old Tupi pyti'u.

parole.significato: peach palm (Bactris gasipaes)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu pupunha.

parole.significato: silky anteater (any anteater in the genus Cyclopes)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu tamanduaí, from Old Tupi tamandûa'i, from Proto-Tupi-Guarani *tamanuʔaʔi.

parole.significato: tucuxi (Sotalia fluviatilis)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu tukuxí, possibly from Old Tupi pukusĩ.

parole.significato: bald uakari (Cacajao calvus)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu wakarí, possibly from Old Tupi akaka'i.

parole.significato: matamata (Chelus fimbriata)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Nheengatu and Old Tupi matamatá.

parole.significato: crab of species Armases benedicti
parole.testo: Borrowed from Old Tupi sarará. Etymology 1, noun 2 sense 1 was first attested in 1900 and is likely a semantic loan from Nheengatu sarará.
